context_and_flow.screen_type: Onboarding screen for a mobile application.
context_and_flow.ux_intent: Welcome the user and initiate the app onboarding flow.
ux_patterns: The illustration is a decorative, full-bleed background that spans the entire screen, serving to establish a calm, reflective tone for 'self-discovery'.
The layout is centered, with typography placed in the upper-middle section for high visibility.
The CTA button is high-contrast against the background illustration.
The UI follows standard mobile patterns for a welcome/onboarding splash screen.

interaction_elements: The CTA button is high-contrast against the background illustration.
visual_keywords: Vector illustration, flat design, calming, nature-themed.
